title.narrative: Foster entrepreneurial learning and the creation of MSMEs for young graduates in Libya

description.narrative: The Ministry of Economy and Industry in Libya requested UNIDO's support to initiate and implement an entrepreneurship programme for youth in Libya (Ministry's letter of 12 Sept 2017). UNIDO has been discussing with the HP Foundation, HP Inc. and GIZ a partnership initiative to foster entrepreneurial learning for young graduates in Libya based on HP's Learning Initiative for Entrepreneurs (HP LIFE), applied in UNIDO's youth employment project in Tunisia (SAP 120357), combined with GIZ' Competency-based economies through formation of enterprise (CEFE) programme. The initiative will be implemented within the South-South Cooperation scheme and aligned to the United Nations Strategic Framework (UNSF) for Libya.
